req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /tasks/{task_id} persists changes so a subsequent GET reflects the update. I design tests covering: (1) EP positive – update an existing task's title/description/completed and verify GET returns the new values exactly; (2) NEG – PUT to a non-existent task_id returns 404 with correct detail; (3) BVA – update with a 100-char title (max boundary) and a 500-char description (max boundary) and verify acceptance; (4) NEG – PUT with title exceeding 100 chars is rejected with 422; (5) STC – update completed from false→true then true→false and verify each state persists; (6) DT – partial update (only one field) leaves other fields unchanged. Each test uses in-process TestClient, seeds via POST, then asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_task_persists_full_update
preconditions: App database is initialised with pre-loaded rows
Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with title='Fixed login bug', description='All done', completed=true
expected: PUT response body contains updated title, description, completed=true, id=7
GET returns HTTP 200 with identical updated values
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Fix login bug', 'description': 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']

put_r = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug', 'description': 'All done', 'completed': True})
assert put_r.status_code == 200
put_body = put_r.json()
assert put_body['id'] == task_id
assert put_body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
assert put_body['description'] == 'All done'
assert put_body['completed'] == True

get_r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert get_r.status_code == 200
get_body = get_r.json()
assert get_body['id'] == task_id
assert get_body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
assert get_body['description'] == 'All done'
assert get_body['completed'] == True

preconditions: A task is created to be updated
actions: PUT /tasks/{id} with title of exactly 100 characters (max allowed)
PUT /tasks/{id} with description of exactly 500 characters (max allowed)
expected: GET returns the 100-char title and 500-char description exactly

from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)

get2 = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert get2.status_code == 200
assert get2.json()['completed'] == False

tests.name: test_put_task_partial_update_preserves_other_fields
preconditions: A task exists with known title, description, and completed values
actions: PUT /tasks/{id} with only 'completed' field set to true
GET /tasks/{id} to verify title and description are unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

assert get_body['description'] == 'Keep me'

tests.name: test_put_task_title_at_boundary_99_100_101
preconditions: Tasks are created for each boundary test
actions: PUT with title of 99 chars — expect 200
PUT with title of 100 chars — expect 200
PUT with title of 101 chars — expect 422
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'BVA title task', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']

title_99 = 'A' * 99
put99 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_99})
assert put99.status_code == 200
assert put99.json()['title'] == title_99
assert len(put99.json()['title']) == 99

title_100 = 'B' * 100
put100 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_100})
assert put100.status_code == 200
assert put100.json()['title'] == title_100
assert len(put100.json()['title']) == 100

title_101 = 'C' * 101
put101 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'title': title_101})
assert put101.status_code == 422

get_r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert get_r.status_code == 200
assert get_r.json()['title'] == title_100

tests.name: test_put_task_description_null_clears_field
preconditions: A task exists with a non-null description
actions: GET /tasks/{id} to verify description is null
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Has description', 'description': 'Some text here', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']
assert create_r.json()['description'] == 'Some text here'

put_r = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json={'description': None})
assert put_r.status_code == 200
put_body = put_r.json()
assert put_body['description'] is None
assert put_body['title'] == 'Has description'
assert put_body['id'] == task_id

get_r = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
assert get_r.status_code == 200
assert get_r.json()['description'] is None
assert get_r.json()['title'] == 'Has description'
